title: InnoTrans Berlin 2026 - Quick Summary
items: **InnoTrans is 22 to 25 September 2026 at Expo Center Berlin, 14055 Berlin.** It is open to trade visitors only.
Official hours are 09:00 to 18:00 from Tuesday to Thursday, then 09:00 to 16:00 on Friday.
The fair uses all 42 halls and a 3.5-kilometre outdoor track display, so treat it as the full daytime anchor.
**Choose one evening area.** City West is the low-friction option, Kulturforum/Potsdamer Platz needs a clear purpose, and the historic centre works best after an early finish or Friday's shorter day.
Use official InnoTrans visitor information for tickets, halls, appointments and live logistics, then check a live BVG or VBB route on the day.
